name: blueprint
description: From idea or new feature to an executable backlog: product definition, technical design routed to the project's own architect, UX/UI design with a Claude Design canvas, and a backlog whose tasks carry a self-sufficient context pack, Ready when and Done when. A fresh reviewer cross-checks every phase against the earlier ones until clean; deterministic lint and guard hooks; checkpoints; a shared online doc for team edits and comments plus a read-only dashboard.
